name: Shaw identifies Marzon

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic Alliance quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Shaw recognizes Marzon as the name behind the alias and says the agent works for Lord Gregor Lescovar. The report turns a vague visitor into a path toward a powerful household. These are Shaw’s conclusions as recorded by the quest, and the Defias inquiry remains bounded by that evidence; no link to Onyxia is introduced.
